gloss: faculty of pharmacy; school of pharmacy

definitions.gloss: faculty of pharmacy; school of pharmacy
definitions.explanation: The division of a university that teaches pharmaceutical science and trains pharmacists.

examples.japanese: {娘|むすめ}は{薬学部|やくがくぶ}に{通|かよ}っている。
examples.english: My daughter attends the faculty of pharmacy.

examples.japanese: {薬学部|やくがくぶ}は{六年制|ろくねんせい}のところが{多|おお}い。
examples.english: Many faculties of pharmacy have a six-year program.

examples.japanese: {薬剤師|やくざいし}になるには{薬学部|やくがくぶ}を{卒業|そつぎょう}する{必要|ひつよう}がある。
examples.english: To become a pharmacist you need to graduate from a faculty of pharmacy.

notes:
Compound of {薬学|やくがく} (pharmaceutical science) + {部|ぶ} (faculty). The six-year program qualifies graduates to sit the national pharmacist exam.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {薬学部|やくがくぶ}に{入|はい}る: to enter the faculty of pharmacy
- {薬学部|やくがくぶ}を{卒業|そつぎょう}する: to graduate from the faculty of pharmacy
- {薬学部|やくがくぶ}の{学生|がくせい}: a pharmacy student
